newsitem.title: UK: GKN says buys 80 pct stake in Italian firm.
newsitem.headline: GKN says buys 80 pct stake in Italian firm.

text.p: Britain's GKN Plc said its Italian unit GKN Birfield S.p.A has acquired an 80 percent shareholding in Italcardano Universal Giunti S.p.A., a vehicle component manufacturer based in Milan in Italy.
GKN declined to specify how much it had paid for the stake, but the target company's sales in 1995 were worth about 25 million stg, of which about 50 percent were outside Italy.
The business had net asset value at Decmber 31, 1995 of some 6.0 million stg, GKN added in a statement.

"The acquisition...represents an excellent opportunity for GKN to enhance sales in an existing core activity and to take advantage of the specialist technology developed by the company," it quoted automotive driveline division chief executive Sarkis Kalyandjian as saying.

GKN units are already significant suppliers to the offroad, commercial and military vehicle segments served by Italcardano, and the group is also a longstanding supplier of propeller shaft components to Italcardano itself.
